subjects.name: Wierzę
subjects.ruleContext: A small everyday object unexpectedly becomes available.
subjects.context: Ability: Wierzę. A small everyday object unexpectedly becomes available. Inventory, item sheet, hotbar and chat icon, typically 16-64 px.
subjects.note: Style replacement at the exact existing filename; fresh GM approval required. No wiring or world writes.
subjects.request: REPLACE cell 1's candle-and-hand idea. Show an ordinary useful object being IMAGINED INTO EXISTENCE: ONE plain generic adult HEAD in SIDE PROFILE at LEFT; ONE broad THOUGHT BUBBLE above-right containing ONE large simple KEY; and ONE complete open PALM below-right holding the SAME simple KEY now tangible. Two large round thought dots connect head and thought bubble. Both keys have one broad round bow, one short thick shaft and two broad teeth. Head is a smooth natural featureless profile with no portrait, beard or hair detail. Compact clear thought-to-real-object composition with broad black separation. No candle, prayer, religious symbol, glitter, tiny rays, magical runes, lettering, numbers or game token.

subjects.name: Wielonożny
subjects.ruleContext: A multi-legged machine moves across difficult ground.
subjects.context: Ability: Wielonożny. A multi-legged machine moves across difficult ground. Inventory, item sheet, hotbar and chat icon, typically 16-64 px.
subjects.note: Style replacement at the exact existing filename; fresh GM approval required. No wiring or world writes.
subjects.request: REVISION cell 2. Keep the broad industrial walker body LEVEL while its articulated legs GRACEFULLY FOLLOW ONE CONTINUOUS HILLY GROUND RIDGE at the bottom. The visible feet REST DIRECTLY ON THE TERRAIN at DIFFERENT HEIGHTS: front foot on a higher crest, middle foot in a lower valley, rear foot on a lower ledge. Each supporting foot's sole touches its own actual ground surface with NO BLACK AIR GAP underneath. One front leg can be lifted mid-step over the next crest; the other feet visibly support the machine. Broad coherent connected legs, simple large joints, complete feet. Terrain is one smooth angular hill ridge, not disconnected rocks below a hovering robot. No gun, fine rubble, bolts, smoke, writing or extra machine.

revisionOf.name: Wielonożny
revisionOf.notes: The legs should connect to the hilly terrain, indicating the robot can move over it gracefully, not just exist over it.
